activity_record_task_outcome.name: activity_record_task_outcome
activity_record_task_outcome.value: (task_id IS NULL) = (task_outcome IS NULL) AND (task_outcome IS NULL OR task_outcome IN ('completed', 'task_cancelled', 'task_already_closed', 'not_linked'))

advance_care_record_cpr.name: advance_care_record_cpr
advance_care_record_cpr.value:
CASE kind
        WHEN 'dnacpr' THEN cpr_decision IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'do_not_attempt_cpr'
        WHEN 'respect' THEN cpr_decision IS NOT NULL
          AND cpr_decision IN ('attempt_cpr', 'do_not_attempt_cpr')
        ELSE cpr_decision IS NULL
      END

advance_care_record_withdrawn.name: advance_care_record_withdrawn
advance_care_record_withdrawn.value: status <> 'withdrawn' OR withdrawn_reason IS NOT NULL

advance_care_record_review.name: advance_care_record_review
advance_care_record_review.value: review_due_on IS NULL OR review_due_on >= completed_on

assessment_task_outcome.name: assessment_task_outcome
assessment_task_outcome.value: (task_id IS NULL) = (task_outcome IS NULL) AND (task_outcome IS NULL OR task_outcome IN ('completed', 'task_cancelled', 'task_already_closed', 'not_linked'))

assessment_correction_reason.name: assessment_correction_reason
assessment_correction_reason.value: supersedes_id IS NULL OR correction_reason IS NOT NULL

body_map_mark_task_outcome.name: body_map_mark_task_outcome
body_map_mark_task_outcome.value: (task_id IS NULL) = (task_outcome IS NULL) AND (task_outcome IS NULL OR task_outcome IN ('completed', 'task_cancelled', 'task_already_closed', 'not_linked'))

care_note_task_outcome.name: care_note_task_outcome
care_note_task_outcome.value: (task_id IS NULL) = (task_outcome IS NULL) AND (task_outcome IS NULL OR task_outcome IN ('completed', 'task_cancelled', 'task_already_closed', 'not_linked'))

care_plan_sign_off.name: care_plan_sign_off
care_plan_sign_off.value:
sign_off_kind IS NULL
        OR sign_off_kind = 'person'
        OR (sign_off_kind = 'representative' AND sign_off_representative_name IS NOT NULL
            AND sign_off_authority IS NOT NULL)
        OR (sign_off_kind = 'unable' AND sign_off_unable_reason IS NOT NULL)

care_plan_action_schedule.name: care_plan_action_schedule
care_plan_action_schedule.value: NOT generates_tasks OR (recurrence IS NOT NULL AND role_key IS NOT NULL)

observation_task_outcome.name: observation_task_outcome
observation_task_outcome.value: (task_id IS NULL) = (task_outcome IS NULL) AND (task_outcome IS NULL OR task_outcome IN ('completed', 'task_cancelled', 'task_already_closed', 'not_linked'))

risk_assessment_closed_reason.name: risk_assessment_closed_reason
risk_assessment_closed_reason.value: status = 'active' OR closed_reason IS NOT NULL

risk_assessment_scales.name: risk_assessment_scales
risk_assessment_scales.value:
(likelihood IS NULL OR likelihood BETWEEN 1 AND 5)
        AND (severity IS NULL OR severity BETWEEN 1 AND 5)
        AND (residual_likelihood IS NULL OR residual_likelihood BETWEEN 1 AND 5)
        AND (residual_severity IS NULL OR residual_severity BETWEEN 1 AND 5)

risk_assessment_rating.name: risk_assessment_rating
risk_assessment_rating.value:
risk_rating IS NOT DISTINCT FROM likelihood * severity
        AND residual_rating IS NOT DISTINCT FROM residual_likelihood * residual_severity

visit_log_task_outcome.name: visit_log_task_outcome
visit_log_task_outcome.value: (task_id IS NULL) = (task_outcome IS NULL) AND (task_outcome IS NULL OR task_outcome IN ('completed', 'task_cancelled', 'task_already_closed', 'not_linked'))

visit_log_visitor.name: visit_log_visitor
visit_log_visitor.value: contact_id IS NOT NULL OR visitor_name IS NOT NULL

visit_log_times.name: visit_log_times
visit_log_times.value: ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at >= occurred_at

best_interests_decision_consultation.name: best_interests_decision_consultation
best_interests_decision_consultation.value:
jsonb_typeof(consultations) = 'array'
        AND (jsonb_array_length(consultations) > 0 OR no_consultation_reason IS NOT NULL)

best_interests_decision_correction_reaso.name: best_interests_decision_correction_reason
best_interests_decision_correction_reaso.value: supersedes_id IS NULL OR correction_reason IS NOT NULL

capacity_assessment_decision_kind.name: capacity_assessment_decision_kind
capacity_assessment_decision_kind.value: decision_kind IS NULL OR decision_kind IN ('care_plan', 'photos', 'social_media', 'sharing', 'marketing', 'ai_processing', 'bed_rails', 'covert_medicines')

capacity_assessment_assessor.name: capacity_assessment_assessor
capacity_assessment_assessor.value: assessor_tenant_user_id IS NOT NULL OR assessor_name IS NOT NULL

capacity_assessment_lacks.name: capacity_assessment_lacks
capacity_assessment_lacks.value:
outcome = 'has_capacity' OR (stage1_impairment AND cardinality(unable_to) > 0
        AND inability_because_of_impairment IS TRUE)

capacity_assessment_correction_reason.name: capacity_assessment_correction_reason
capacity_assessment_correction_reason.value: supersedes_id IS NULL OR correction_reason IS NOT NULL

consent_record_given_by.name: consent_record_given_by
consent_record_given_by.value:
given_by_kind IN ('person', 'representative')
        AND (given_by_kind = 'representative') = (representative_kind IS NOT NULL)

consent_record_representative.name: consent_record_representative
consent_record_representative.value:
representative_kind IS NULL OR (representative_kind IN ('lpa_health_welfare', 'lpa_property_financial', 'deputy', 'appointee', 'imca', 'advocate', 'family_or_friend')
        AND (representative_contact_id IS NOT NULL OR representative_name IS NOT NULL))

consent_record_deputy_scope.name: consent_record_deputy_scope
consent_record_deputy_scope.value: deputy_scope IS NULL OR deputy_scope IN ('personal_welfare', 'property_and_affairs')

consent_record_expiry.name: consent_record_expiry
consent_record_expiry.value: expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > given_at

consent_record_withdrawn.name: consent_record_withdrawn
consent_record_withdrawn.value: withdrawn_at IS NULL OR (withdrawn_reason IS NOT NULL AND withdrawn_at >= given_at)

dols_authorisation_outcome.name: dols_authorisation_outcome
dols_authorisation_outcome.value:
outcome IN ('pending', 'granted', 'not_granted', 'withdrawn')
        AND (outcome = 'pending' OR outcome_at IS NOT NULL)

dols_authorisation_withdrawn.name: dols_authorisation_withdrawn
dols_authorisation_withdrawn.value: outcome <> 'withdrawn' OR withdrawal_reason IS NOT NULL

dols_authorisation_period.name: dols_authorisation_period
dols_authorisation_period.value: granted_to IS NULL OR granted_from IS NULL OR granted_to > granted_from

dols_authorisation_ended.name: dols_authorisation_ended
dols_authorisation_ended.value: ended_at IS NULL OR ended_reason IS NOT NULL

dols_legal_change_review_decision.name: dols_legal_change_review_decision
dols_legal_change_review_decision.value: decision IS NULL OR decision IN ('still_deprived', 'no_longer_deprived', 'in_doubt')

dols_legal_change_review_objection.name: dols_legal_change_review_objection
dols_legal_change_review_objection.value: objection IS NULL OR objection IN ('objects', 'does_not_object', 'fluctuates', 'unclear')

dols_legal_change_review_reviewed.name: dols_legal_change_review_reviewed
dols_legal_change_review_reviewed.value: state NOT IN ('reviewed', 'referred') OR (decision IS NOT NULL AND decided_at IS NOT NULL)

dols_legal_change_review_referred.name: dols_legal_change_review_referred
dols_legal_change_review_referred.value: state <> 'referred' OR referral_sent_at IS NOT NULL

dols_legal_change_review_closed.name: dols_legal_change_review_closed
dols_legal_change_review_closed.value: state <> 'closed' OR closed_reason IS NOT NULL

break_glass_reason_code.name: break_glass_reason_code
break_glass_reason_code.value: reason_code IS NULL OR reason_code IN ('emergency_care', 'covering_another_area', 'safeguarding', 'incident_or_complaint', 'request_from_professional', 'other')

contact_authority_scope.name: contact_authority_scope
contact_authority_scope.value: authority_scope IS NULL OR authority_scope IN ('personal_welfare', 'property_affairs', 'both')

person_communication_none_identified.name: person_communication_none_identified
person_communication_none_identified.value:
communication_needs_status <> 'none_identified' OR (communication_needs = '[]'::jsonb
        AND communication_needs_confirmed_by IS NOT NULL AND communication_needs_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL)

placement_trial_end.name: placement_trial_end
placement_trial_end.value: trial_ends_on IS NULL OR trial_ends_on > start_date

about_me_share_link_revoked.name: about_me_share_link_revoked
about_me_share_link_revoked.value: revoked_at IS NULL OR revoked_reason IS NOT NULL

admission_decision_trial.name: admission_decision_trial
admission_decision_trial.value: trial_ends_on IS NULL OR planned_admission_on IS NULL OR trial_ends_on > planned_admission_on

admission_decision_correction_reason.name: admission_decision_correction_reason
admission_decision_correction_reason.value: supersedes_id IS NULL OR correction_reason IS NOT NULL

bed_occupancy_range.name: bed_occupancy_range
bed_occupancy_range.value: to_date IS NULL OR to_date > from_date

break_glass_weekly_report_review.name: break_glass_weekly_report_review
break_glass_weekly_report_review.value:
(reviewed_by IS NULL) = (reviewed_at IS NULL)
        AND (supersedes_id IS NULL) = (reviewed_by IS NULL)

care_plan_change_source_once.name: care_plan_change_source_once
care_plan_change_source_once.where: source_id IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL

care_plan_change_source.name: care_plan_change_source
care_plan_change_source.value:
(source_type IS NULL) = (source_id IS NULL) AND (source_type IS NULL
        OR source_type IN ('incident', 'hospital_transfer', 'care_note', 'assessment', 'other'))

care_plan_change_reviewed.name: care_plan_change_reviewed
care_plan_change_reviewed.value: review_record_id IS NULL OR reviewed_on IS NOT NULL

exit_checklist_item_done.name: exit_checklist_item_done
exit_checklist_item_done.value: status = 'pending' OR (done_by IS NOT NULL AND done_at IS NOT NULL)

exit_checklist_item_not_required.name: exit_checklist_item_not_required
exit_checklist_item_not_required.value: status <> 'not_required' OR (allow_not_required AND reason IS NOT NULL)

exit_checklist_item_evidence.name: exit_checklist_item_evidence
exit_checklist_item_evidence.value:
(evidence_type IS NULL) = (evidence_id IS NULL) AND (evidence_type IS NULL
        OR evidence_type IN ('statutory_notification', 'document', 'ledger_entry', 'note'))

exit_record_one_open.name: exit_record_one_open
exit_record_one_open.where: state NOT IN ('closed', 'cancelled') AND deleted_at IS NULL

exit_record_status_before.name: exit_record_status_before
exit_record_status_before.value: status_before IS NULL OR status_before IN ('active', 'on_leave', 'in_hospital')

exit_record_state.name: exit_record_state
exit_record_state.value:
state IN ('planned', 'left', 'recorded', 'awaiting_return', 'closed', 'cancelled') AND CASE WHEN kind = 'death'
        THEN state NOT IN ('planned', 'left') ELSE state <> 'recorded' END

exit_record_death.name: exit_record_death
exit_record_death.value:
CASE WHEN kind = 'death'
        THEN place_of_death IN ('care_home', 'hospital', 'elsewhere') AND left_at IS NOT NULL
        ELSE place_of_death IS NULL AND death_expected IS NULL END

exit_record_destination.name: exit_record_destination
exit_record_destination.value:
destination_type IS NULL OR destination_type IN ('own_home', 'family_home', 'care_home',
        'hospital', 'hospice', 'supported_living', 'other')

exit_record_left.name: exit_record_left
exit_record_left.value: state IN ('planned', 'cancelled') OR left_at IS NOT NULL

exit_record_cancelled.name: exit_record_cancelled
exit_record_cancelled.value: state <> 'cancelled' OR cancelled_reason IS NOT NULL

exit_record_closed.name: exit_record_closed
exit_record_closed.value: state <> 'closed' OR closed_at IS NOT NULL

hospital_transfer_one_open.name: hospital_transfer_one_open
hospital_transfer_one_open.where: returned_at IS NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL

hospital_transfer_returned.name: hospital_transfer_returned
hospital_transfer_returned.value: returned_at IS NULL OR returned_at >= left_at

hospital_transfer_acknowledgement.name: hospital_transfer_acknowledgement
hospital_transfer_acknowledgement.value: (ack_by IS NULL) = (ack_at IS NULL) AND (ack_by IS NULL) = (ack_reason IS NULL)

key_issue_returned.name: key_issue_returned
key_issue_returned.value: returned_on IS NULL OR returned_on >= issued_on

key_issue_lost.name: key_issue_lost
key_issue_lost.value: reported_lost_on IS NULL OR reported_lost_on >= issued_on

key_issue_once.name: key_issue_once
key_issue_once.value: returned_on IS NULL OR reported_lost_on IS NULL

pre_admission_assessment_involvement.name: pre_admission_assessment_involvement
pre_admission_assessment_involvement.value: person_involved IS NOT FALSE OR involvement_reason IS NOT NULL

property_item_acknowledgement.name: property_item_acknowledgement
property_item_acknowledgement.value:
ack_signer IN ('person', 'representative', 'unable_to_sign') AND CASE WHEN ack_signer = 'unable_to_sign'
        THEN ack_unable_reason IS NOT NULL ELSE ack_name IS NOT NULL END

property_item_witness.name: property_item_witness
property_item_witness.value: witnessed_by IS NULL OR witnessed_by <> recorded_by

property_item_returned.name: property_item_returned
property_item_returned.value:
status <> 'returned' OR (returned_on IS NOT NULL AND return_recipient_name IS NOT NULL
        AND return_recipient_capacity IN ('person', 'representative', 'personal_representative', 'receiving_provider') AND returned_by IS NOT NULL
        AND return_signer IN ('person', 'representative', 'unable_to_sign'))

property_item_disposed.name: property_item_disposed
property_item_disposed.value:
status <> 'disposed' OR (disposed_on IS NOT NULL AND disposal_reason IS NOT NULL
        AND disposed_by IS NOT NULL AND disposal_witnessed_by IS NOT NULL
        AND disposal_witnessed_by <> disposed_by)

property_item_lost.name: property_item_lost
property_item_lost.value: status <> 'lost' OR (lost_on IS NOT NULL AND loss_incident_id IS NOT NULL)

review_record_family.name: review_record_family
review_record_family.value:
(kind = 'family_involvement') = (family_involvement_kind IS NOT NULL)
        AND (family_involvement_kind IS NULL OR family_involvement_kind IN ('attended_review', 'contributed', 'invited_declined', 'person_declines_involvement', 'no_family_or_representative'))

review_record_correction_reason.name: review_record_correction_reason
review_record_correction_reason.value: supersedes_id IS NULL OR correction_reason IS NOT NULL

sharing_decision_recipient.name: sharing_decision_recipient
sharing_decision_recipient.value:
CASE recipient_kind
        WHEN 'family' THEN recipient_contact_id IS NOT NULL AND recipient_tenant_user_id IS NULL
        WHEN 'professional' THEN recipient_tenant_user_id IS NOT NULL AND recipient_contact_id IS NULL
        WHEN 'link' THEN recipient_contact_id IS NULL AND recipient_tenant_user_id IS NULL
        ELSE false END

sharing_decision_consent_given_by.name: sharing_decision_consent_given_by
sharing_decision_consent_given_by.value: consent_given_by IS NULL OR consent_given_by IN ('person', 'authority_holder')

sharing_decision_authority_role.name: sharing_decision_authority_role
sharing_decision_authority_role.value: authority_role IS NULL OR authority_role IN ('lpa_health_welfare', 'lpa_property_finance', 'deputy_personal_welfare', 'deputy_property_affairs', 'appointee')

sharing_decision_withdrawn.name: sharing_decision_withdrawn
sharing_decision_withdrawn.value: withdrawn_at IS NULL OR withdrawn_reason IS NOT NULL

sharing_decision_suspended.name: sharing_decision_suspended
sharing_decision_suspended.value: suspended_at IS NULL OR suspended_reason IS NOT NULL

sharing_decision_order_sections.name: sharing_decision_order_sections
sharing_decision_order_sections.value:
(authority_order_sections IS NULL OR (cardinality(authority_order_sections) > 0
        AND authority_order_sections <@ ARRAY['about_me', 'daily_updates', 'photos', 'activities_and_visits', 'care_plan', 'health_summary', 'medicines', 'appointments', 'finance', 'benefits', 'documents']::text[]))
        AND (authority_role IS NULL
          OR authority_role NOT IN ('deputy_personal_welfare', 'deputy_property_affairs')
          OR authority_order_sections IS NOT NULL)

sharing_decision_suspension_open_key.name: sharing_decision_suspension_open_key
sharing_decision_suspension_open_key.where: lifted_at IS NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL

sharing_decision_suspension_period.name: sharing_decision_suspension_period
sharing_decision_suspension_period.value: lifted_at IS NULL OR lifted_at > suspended_at

welcome_checklist_item_done.name: welcome_checklist_item_done
welcome_checklist_item_done.value: status = 'pending' OR (done_by IS NOT NULL AND done_at IS NOT NULL)

welcome_checklist_item_not_applicable.name: welcome_checklist_item_not_applicable
welcome_checklist_item_not_applicable.value: status <> 'not_applicable' OR (allow_not_applicable AND reason IS NOT NULL)

notification_escalate_idx.name: notification_escalate_idx
notification_escalate_idx.where: acknowledged_at IS NULL AND escalate_at IS NOT NULL

legal_hold_target.name: legal_hold_target
legal_hold_target.value: "legal_hold"."person_id" IS NOT NULL OR ("legal_hold"."subject_type" IS NOT NULL AND "legal_hold"."subject_id" IS NOT NULL)

candour_record_threshold.name: candour_record_threshold
candour_record_threshold.value:
(threshold_notifiable IS NULL) = (threshold_decided_at IS NULL)
        AND (threshold_notifiable IS NULL OR threshold_decided_by IS NOT NULL)

incident_severity.name: incident_severity
incident_severity.value: severity IS NULL OR severity IN ('negligible', 'minor', 'moderate', 'major', 'catastrophic')

incident_harm_grade.name: incident_harm_grade
incident_harm_grade.value: harm_grade IS NULL OR harm_grade IN ('none', 'low', 'moderate', 'severe', 'fatal')

incident_closed.name: incident_closed
incident_closed.value: (status = 'closed') = (closed_at IS NOT NULL AND closed_by IS NOT NULL AND closed_reason IS NOT NULL)

incident_closed_by_other.name: incident_closed_by_other
incident_closed_by_other.value: closed_by IS NULL OR closed_by <> raised_by

incident_found_at.name: incident_found_at
incident_found_at.value: found_at IS NULL OR found_at >= occurred_at

incident_person_one_person.name: incident_person_one_person
incident_person_one_person.where: person_id IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL

incident_person_one_user.name: incident_person_one_user
incident_person_one_user.where: tenant_user_id IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL

incident_person_kind.name: incident_person_kind
incident_person_kind.value:
kind IN ('service_user', 'worker', 'other_not_at_work')
        AND (kind = 'service_user') = (person_id IS NOT NULL)
        AND (kind <> 'worker' OR tenant_user_id IS NOT NULL OR other_name IS NOT NULL)
        AND (kind <> 'other_not_at_work' OR other_name IS NOT NULL)
        AND (kind = 'worker' OR tenant_user_id IS NULL)

investigation_method.name: investigation_method
investigation_method.value:
method IS NULL OR method IN ('root_cause_analysis', 'five_whys', 'fishbone',
        'after_action_review', 'swarm_huddle', 'other')

investigation_completed.name: investigation_completed
investigation_completed.value:
(status = 'completed') = (completed_at IS NOT NULL)
        AND (status = 'open' OR (findings IS NOT NULL AND lessons IS NOT NULL))

statutory_notification_not_required.name: statutory_notification_not_required
statutory_notification_not_required.value: status <> 'not_required' OR not_required_reason IS NOT NULL

statutory_notification_submitted.name: statutory_notification_submitted
statutory_notification_submitted.value:
status <> 'submitted' OR (submitted_at IS NOT NULL AND submitted_by IS NOT NULL
        AND (external_reference IS NOT NULL OR evidence_document_id IS NOT NULL))

statutory_notification_dols.name: statutory_notification_dols
statutory_notification_dols.value:
(kind = 'cqc_reg18_dols_outcome') = (dols_authorisation_id IS NOT NULL)
        AND (dols_authorisation_id IS NULL OR person_id IS NOT NULL)

task_cancel_code.name: task_cancel_code
task_cancel_code.value: cancel_code IS NULL OR (status = 'cancelled' AND cancel_code IN ('paused_while_away', 'ended_at_exit', 'exit_recorded_in_error', 'planned_exit_cancelled', 'missed_before_return_recorded'))

task_series_inactive_code.name: task_series_inactive_code
task_series_inactive_code.value: inactive_code IS NULL OR (NOT active AND inactive_code IN ('paused_while_away', 'ended_at_exit', 'exit_recorded_in_error', 'planned_exit_cancelled', 'missed_before_return_recorded'))
